summary: Validated auth-removal public flow on external preview URL. Fresh browser loads Overview directly with no login UI, no /api/auth/login network calls, and no qlub_token creation. Reload remains accessible, and invalid legacy qlub_token does not block access. Backend public-data regression tests passed (7/7). All five sidebar pages navigate correctly; Expo search/filters and VoC filters work without triggering paid live AI endpoints. Desktop 1920x800 is stable. Mobile 390x844 remains unusable due to non-responsive shell (fixed 280px sidebar plus main left padding 280px), producing horizontal overflow.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile viewport is functionally broken: sidebar is fixed at 280px and main content always has pl-[280px], leaving extremely narrow content area and forcing horizontal overflow.

issues: Horizontal overflow present (doc/body scroll width ~583 on viewport 390).
Dashboard reading/interaction area is heavily constrained by permanent 280px sidebar occupying most width.
Full-width desktop composition does not adapt for handset usage.

action_items: Implement minimal responsive shell: keep desktop fixed sidebar + pl-[280px], but on small screens use off-canvas/collapsible sidebar and set main content padding-left to 0 (e.g., mobile: pl-0, lg+: pl-[280px]).
Add a mobile nav trigger (hamburger) to open/close sidebar; keep current desktop behavior unchanged.
Re-test at 390x844 after shell fix for remaining Overview overflow hotspots.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js hardcodes main layout to pl-[280px] for all breakpoints; this is the direct root cause of mobile unusability.
Sidebar.jsx hardcodes fixed width w-[280px] with fixed positioning for all breakpoints; no responsive escape path is implemented.
No auth gate references are observed in current App shell path; API integration remains public as intended.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all auth-removal and navigation flows pass; mobile shell responsiveness fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright run validated: no login screen/password/logout/secured badge; 0 requests to /api/auth/login; localStorage qlub_token remains null on fresh load; invalid token does not block Overview. Verified no paid live AI calls during requested checks (0 requests to /api/voice-of-customer/sync and /api/outreach/generate). Desktop screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iteration_3/desktop_1920x800.jpg. Mobile screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iteration_3/mobile_390x844.jpg. Mobile metrics captured: sidebar_w=280, main_padding_left=280px, doc_scroll_w=583 on viewport 390.
rca of the issue: Repro: open app at 390x844 -> sidebar stays fixed at 280px while main retains 280px left padding -> content gets compressed to a narrow strip and page overflows horizontally. Root cause: desktop shell classes are unconditional (Sidebar width fixed + App main pl-[280px]) without breakpoint-specific overrides. Mitigation: apply responsive class split (mobile pl-0 + hidden/off-canvas sidebar, desktop pl-[280px] + fixed sidebar).
